expected_behavior_change: Current Admin runtime shows a compact R4 diagnostic marker with production source SHA, sync state, outbox count and canonical hydration fingerprint.
If normal Safari still runs an older loaded bundle, the R4 marker is absent, proving the stale runtime path without clearing cache.
If R4 is present, the marker exposes whether a persisted outbox still exists after canonical hydration.
non_goals: No outbox pruning semantic change in R4.
No Customer, Owner, SMM or SMT changes.
